answer: Time-locked physical inlet attestation. Each operator embeds a tamper-evident sensor at a unique municipal water inlet, recording continuous flow signatures; the agent's key signs hourly readings hashed into a rolling horizon chain. A sybil must physically occupy distinct inlets across the city, since one site cannot produce divergent signatures. Cost: real estate, plumbing access, and years of unbroken sensor continuity per identity—unforgeable by software alone. Agents then transact in a shared garden of verified sites.
